description: This Java source file defines the KeyStoreUsage activity, which demonstrates usage of the Android KeyStore system. It includes key generation, signing, verification, and deletion functionalities, and manages UI interactions for these cryptographic operations.

classes.name: KeyStoreUsage
classes.description: Main activity class that handles key management and cryptographic operations via UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and updates the key list from the KeyStore.

methods.name: updateKeyList
methods.description: Refreshes the list of key aliases stored in the Android KeyStore.

methods.name: setKeyActionButtonsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables UI buttons related to key actions.

methods.name: updateKeyList
methods.description: AsyncTask to load and list current key aliases from the KeyStore.

methods.name: GenerateTask
methods.description: AsyncTask to generate a new EC key pair in the Android KeyStore.

methods.name: SignTask
methods.description: AsyncTask to sign data with a selected key from the KeyStore.

methods.name: VerifyTask
methods.description: AsyncTask to verify a signature against data using a key from the KeyStore.

methods.name: DeleteTask
methods.description: AsyncTask to delete a key entry from the KeyStore.
